claims: Michael B. Jordan won the 2026 Oscar for Best Actor for his role in Sinners.

The 2026 Best Actor Oscar nominees included Michael B. Jordan (Sinners), Timothée Chalamet (Marty Supreme), Leonardo DiCaprio (One Battle After Another), Ethan Hawke (Blue Moon), and Wagner Moura (The Secret Agent).
Michael B. Jordan was the winner of Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) for Sinners.
Timothée Chalamet was a Best Actor nominee at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) for Marty Supreme.
Leonardo DiCaprio was a Best Actor nominee at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) for One Battle After Another.
Ethan Hawke was a Best Actor nominee at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) for Blue Moon.
Wagner Moura was a Best Actor nominee at the 98th Academy Awards (2026) for The Secret Agent.
Deadline notes that Michael B. Jordan's win for his dual role in Sinners marks his first Academy Award.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony was held on March 15, 2026, according to NPR.
